distill.rationale: Narrow lifecycle/command compatibility repair over an unchanged ten-unit decomposition.

techniques.application: Context, staging, validation, and gated handoff remain ordered.
Every source and target is bound by exact path, SHA-256, and size.
Staged candidate bytes are exercised through installed WPRA, readiness, and controller consumers.
Lifecycle and command repairs carry positive and adversarial regressions with preserved exits.
Apply, acceptance, selection, chain approval, and Victor review remain distinct.
Proposal pass keeps mutation_ready false and authority none.
Later apply, closure, acceptance, selection, chain, and review gates remain explicit.
Evidence is grouped under one run-local dispatch without telemetry mutation.
